rest-sandbox-recommend-test-server-with-:
$1

Digniin: REST Sandbox wuxuu si caadi ah u fuliyaa wicitaannada isagoo adeegsanaya kaydka xogta wax-soo-saarka (production database). Si looga fogaado wax-ka-beddello aan ula kac ahayn oo lagu sameeyo nuxurka tooska ah, ka dooro server-ka bacaadka ($2) liiska hoos u dhaca ee server-ka ka hor intaadan samayn codsiyada POST, PUT, PATCH ama DELETE.

rest-param-desc-module-spec-lang: Koodhka luqadda ee lagu soo celinayo qeexitaanka OpenAPI
rest-param-desc-diff-type:
Nooca isbeddelka, mid ka mid ah kuwa soo socda:
  • `0`: Nuxur isku mid ah oo ku jira labada dib u eegis, oo lagu daray si uu u bixiyo macnaha guud marka la daawanayo isbarbardhigga isbeddellada. API-gu wuxuu soo celiyaa ilaa laba sadar oo macnaha guud ah oo ku wareegsan isbeddel kasta.
  • `1`: Sadar ku jira dib u eegista `to` laakiin aan ku jirin dib u eegista `from`.
  • `2`: Sadar ku jira dib u eegista `from` laakiin aan ku jirin dib u eegista `to`.
  • `3`: Sadar ay ku jiraan qoraallo ku kala duwan labada dib u eegis.
  • `4`: Meesha nuxurka la raray uu ku yaal dib u eegista `from`.
  • `5`: Meesha nuxurka la raray uu ku yaal dib u eegista `to`. Noocani sidoo kale wuxuu ka koobnaan karaa kala duwanaanshaha heerka erayada ee u dhexeeya labada dib u eegis.
rest-param-desc-diff-linenumber: Lambarka sadar ee isbeddelka oo ku salaysan dib u eegista `to`
rest-param-desc-diff-text: Qoraalka sadar-ka, oo ay ku jiraan waxyaabaha labada dib-u-eegis ka yimid. Haddii sadar uu ka kooban yahay qoraal kala duwan labada dib-u-eegis, isticmaal highlightRanges si aad u muujiso qoraalka lagu daray iyo kan laga saaray. Haddii sadar uu yahay sadar cusub, API-gu wuxuu soo celinayaa "" (xadhig madhan).
rest-param-desc-diff-highlightranges: Liis walxo ah oo tilmaamaya halka iyo qaabka qoraalka loo iftiiminayo si muuqaal ahaan loogu muujiyo isbeddellada
rest-param-desc-diff-highlightranges-sta: Meesha qoraalka la iftiimiyay uu ka bilaabanayo, oo lagu cabbiray baytyada laga bilaabo bilowga safka
rest-param-desc-diff-highlightranges-len: Dhererka qaybta la iftiimiyay, oo lagu cabbiray baytyada
rest-param-desc-diff-highlightranges-typ: Nooca iftiiminta: 0 wuxuu muujinayaa wax lagu daray, 1 wuxuu muujinayaa wax laga saaray
rest-param-desc-diff-moveinfo: Tilmaamayaal muuqaal ah oo la adeegsado marka goobta cutubku ay ka duwan tahay labada dib u eegis. Walxaha moveInfo waxay ku yimaadaan labo-labo gudaha kala duwanaanshaha.
rest-param-desc-diff-moveinfo-id: Aqoonsiga cutubka uu sharxayo shayga kala duwanaanshaha
rest-param-desc-diff-moveinfo-linkid: Aqoonsiga cutubka la xiriira. Nooca 4, waa goobta ku jirta dib-u-eegista `to`. Nooca 5, waa goobta ku jirta dib-u-eegista `from`.
rest-param-desc-diff-moveinfo-linkdirect: Tilmaame muuqaal ah oo muujinaya xiriirka u dhexeeya labada goobood. Isticmaal hantidan si aad ugu muujiso astaan fallaad gudaha kala duwanaanshaha. 0 wuxuu tilmaamayaa in cutubka linkId uu ka hooseeyo cutubka id ee bogga. 1 wuxuu tilmaamayaa in cutubka linkId uu ka sarreeyo cutubka id.
rest-param-desc-diff-offset: Goobta sadar-ka oo lagu cabbirayo baytyada laga bilaabo bilowga bogga
rest-param-desc-diff-offset-from: Baytka ugu horreeya ee sadar-ka ee ku jira dib u eegista `from`, ama null haddii sadar-ku uusan jirin
rest-param-desc-diff-offset-to: Baytka ugu horreeya ee sadar-ka ee ku jira dib u eegista `to`, ama null haddii sadar-ku uusan jirin

rest-endpoint-desc-post-dbsc-refresh: Waxay cusboonaysiisaa aqoonsiga ku xiran [kal-fadhi qalab ku xiran](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-dbsc/) (DBSC).

rest-openapispec-genericerrorresponse-v2: Jawaabta khaladka ee qaybaha isticmaalaya nooca 2.0 ee qaabka khaladka.
rest-openapispec-genericerrorresponse-re: Jawaabta khaladka ee qaabka ku habboon RESTBase, oo la soo celiyo marka codsigu leeyahay madaxa "x-restbase-compat: true".
rest-openapispec-genericerrorresponse-pr: Weedha sababta caadiga ah ee koodhka xaaladda HTTP, tusaale ahaan "Lama helin".
Furaha farriinta ee tilmaamaya khaladka. Waxa uu joogaa oo keliya khaladaadka la turjumay.
Aqoonsiga codsiga. Waxa uu joogaa oo keliya khaladaadka server-ka; ku dar marka aad soo gudbinayso khaladka.
Faahfaahinta habaysan ee ka reebitaanka sababay khaladka. Waxa uu joogaa oo keliya marka wiki-ga loo habeeyay inuu muujiyo faahfaahinta ka reebitaanka.
Koodh ay mashiinku akhriyi karo oo tilmaamaya khaladka. Waxa uu joogaa oo keliya khaladaadka la turjumay.

Macluumaad ogaanshaha oo ku saabsan codsiga, oo waxtar leh marka la soo sheegayo khaladka. Had iyo jeer wuxuu ka kooban yahay "module", waxaana laga yaabaa inuu ka koobnaado "request_id", "method", "uri" iyo "url". Nuxurka shaygani kama mid aha heshiiska API-ga, wuxuuna isbeddeli karaa wakhti kasta.
